Donaldson Capital Management Lowered Its Walt Disney Co (DIS) Stake; 4 Analysts Bullish IG Design Group Plc (LON:IGR) 
April 23, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia 
Donaldson Capital Management Llc decreased Walt Disney Co (DIS) stake by 9.12% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Donaldson Capital Management Llc sold 2,989 shares as Walt Disney Co (DIS)’s stock declined 8.57%. The Donaldson Capital Management Llc holds 29,796 shares with $3.20 million value, down from 32,785 last quarter. Walt Disney Co now has $150.73B valuation. The stock decreased 0.64% or $0.65 during the last trading session, reaching $100.24. About 6.40 million shares traded. The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has declined 11.59% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.14% the S&P500.

IG Design Group Plc designs, manufactures, sources, and distributes gift packaging, greeting cards, partyware, stationery, creative play, and gifting products in the United Kingdom, Asia, the United States, Europe, Australia, and internationally. The company has market cap of 278.30 million GBP. It serves mid-sized retailers, other manufacturers and wholesalers of greetings products, service merchandisers, and trading companies. It has a 28.1 P/E ratio. The firm was formerly known as International Greetings plc and changed its name to IG Design Group Plc in June 2016.
